title: NANUQ theorem extremality and formalization register
scope: Original NANUQ on finite binary semidirected LSA outer-labeled planar galled networks, plus explicitly separated parameter and representation questions.
completeness: Systematic finite audit of identified dimensions; not a claim to exhaust every conceivable mathematical generalization.

statusLegend.ESTABLISHED_UPSTREAM: Accepted in the main thread; not rebuilt end-to-end here.

statusLegend.COMPUTER_ASSISTED: Unbounded transfer argument plus finite computation.
statusLegend.OPEN: An unresolved target, not a proved claim.
statusLegend.SPECIFICATION: Required distinction or workflow contract; not a new theorem.

formalizationContracts: Finite binary multigraph with taxon labels, hybrid directions, rooted LSA partner, galledness, and outer-labeled embedding.
Independent incoming-edge choices, recursive pruning, degree-two suppression, and displayed-tree support.
Correct coefficient formula, inversion factor 1/2, uniqueness in a fixed circular order, and support.
Restriction commutes with displayed-tree selection and matches source induced-quarnet support.
Every admitted bloblet opens to an adjacent-copy plane binary tree, preserving original taxon order.
Minimal subtree construction, suppression invariance, and extension of partial occurrence selections.
Each anchor coefficient depends on at most six retained labels and the same two boundary gaps.
Every reduced occurrence tree appears in the finite ordered-tree enumerator; state quotient preserves evaluation.
Kernel-check nonnegativity and absence-boundary-topology implies zero for every finite anchor coefficient.
W(m)=sum m_p*m_q*M_pq including diagonal, overlapping anchors, and small-port conventions.
For nontrivial circular S, displayed S iff its four adjacent boundary taxa display bc|ad.
Two explicit positive anchors for internal splits and one for singleton splits.
Positive coefficient restricts to <=6 labels, finite vanishing excludes absent boundary quartet, and selection extends.
Capping blobs preserves rooted LSA partner, galledness, binary degree, and outer-face ports.
Port blocks partition all taxa, are nonempty, and occur consecutively in one global order.
Choices factor by blob; every selected-tree branching contribution has unique local ownership.
A quartet is bridge-resolved or has a unique four-port central blob; compare both supports and marginals.
Derive, rather than assume, the sum of local W pullbacks for the source d_N.
Both inclusions, especially branching endpoints bypassing zero two-port matrices.
Positive weight>=1, singleton>=n-2, mass-sensitive bounds, and equality witnesses.
At most two displayed planar quartet topologies; 2rho integral; sum gives integral d_N.
Entrywise error<1/2 recovers integer d; tree/cycle midpoint proves endpoint impossibility.
Check cycle/tree and non-outer theta objects, source predicates, switchings, matrices, and support.
Check normalization by positive gcd, five/six equality, and a row first occurring at five.
All dependencies discharged from source predicates; inspect axioms and theorem signatures.
